bugs_found: Malformed .banking-profile can crash contract-presence, contract-validate, floats-check and all because load_profile does not catch YAML errors or validate the loaded type.
Schema load failures in review-validate and contract-validate are not caught, producing tracebacks instead of documented exit code 2.
review-gate never checks that the latest overall round verdict is approve despite documenting it as a pass condition, so a later non-code-reviewer rejection can pass incorrectly.
review-gate dedupes findings by filename sort order, not by round number and agent as documented; lexicographic ordering can make round-10 sort before round-2 and use stale acknowledgements.

contract-presence matches contracts by name globally per file, so one ---contract block can satisfy a same-named nested function or method elsewhere in the file without being attached to that function.
function_is_exempted assumes every exemption has path and function_pattern keys; malformed or partially valid profiles can raise KeyError.
